description: This file defines a PHP class 'tinymce' that provides methods to generate TinyMCE editor instances as HTML textareas, including methods to customize and output HTML code for the editor. The class includes properties and methods related to the configuration and creation of the text editor for web pages.

classes.name: tinymce
classes.description: A PHP class that facilitates the creation of a TinyMCE web editor instance as an HTML textarea, with customization options for rows, columns, and instance name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the tinymce object with a given instance name and default value.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the editor and outputs it directly.

methods.name: CreateHtml
methods.description: Returns the HTML string for the textarea configured as a TinyMCE editor, with optional rows and columns parameters.
